findings.summary: A spoiled lambda statement is a different class from the one the first unwrap checked, so it reached SQLite with an explicit id or a sequence write; fixed in 89d7653 and listed so the class of miss is on record.
A null lambda whose private resolved attribute is overwritten by hand with None is not refused; it cannot be built through the public API and cannot execute.
The new lambda bullet in the audit guard's module docstring sits before the existing Not covered paragraph, so that paragraph now reads as part of the lambda bullet.
An insert into the audit table with an explicit id nested inside a CTE is not refused by the guard; SQLite does not accept DML in a CTE, so it matters on Postgres only, and it predates lambdas.
Over-refusal of harmless lambda statements was probed by both QA launches but only some of those cases are pinned by tests in the repository.
